## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `stripe-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to the Stripe dashboard

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to your [Stripe dashboard](https://dashboard.stripe.com/login). -->

## Step 3: Navigate to the developer portal

1. Select **Developers** in the top-right corner of the Stripe dashboard.

## Step 4: Get your secret key

1. Select **API keys** in the left sidebar.
2. <!-- manual: Copy the Secret key — this is the token used to authenticate the Stripe connector. -->
